summary: Flight plan form — select aircraft from registered list
description: Users can select a registered aircraft from a searchable dropdown when creating a new flight plan. The dropdown is populated from the aircraft registry API.

acs.text: Aircraft dropdown shows all active aircraft from the registry on page load
Typing in the dropdown filters the list by registration number or aircraft type
Selecting an aircraft pre-fills the Aircraft Type and Registration Number fields on the form

out_of_scope: Adding new aircraft from the flight plan form

sections.content: Searchable aircraft selector for the flight plan creation form. Integrates with the aircraft registry API.

The aircraft registry API is a Node.js REST service. The endpoint GET /api/aircraft-registry returns a JSON array of aircraft objects. Authentication uses JWT bearer tokens stored in browser localStorage. The frontend is built in React 18 with TypeScript. The dropdown component uses the react-select library (v5) configured for async loading.

Test environment is staging.jetnet.internal. The QA team uses Azure DevOps Test Plans for manual TC tracking. The team has 2 QA engineers. Test execution is manual — no automated test suite exists yet.
